999008199.text: はあ、はあ……やった、倒せた……

localizations.en: Hah... hah... We did it... We took it down...

999008199.text: 兄さん、大丈夫？　傷口……また開いてない？

localizations.en: Are you okay? Your wounds... they didn't open up again, did they?

999008199.text:
ああ、大丈夫だ。少なくとも生きてる……
今はそれで十分だ

localizations.en: Yeah, I'm fine. At least I'm alive... That's enough for now.

999008199.text: 説得、できたのかな……

少なくとも、これくらいで済んだのなら
１週間かけて準備した甲斐があったと思うよ

localizations.en: Well, if this is all we had to deal with, I'd say the week of preparation was worth it.

999008199.text:
アタシの知ってる知識を総動員して作った
諸島同盟旅のしおり、渡せなかった……

localizations.en: I put everything I knew into making that Archipelago Travel Guide, and I didn't even get to give it to them...

999008199.text:
まあ、あの二人の場合、誰かのお仕着せじゃなくて
自分で楽しみを探してるほうが性に合うよ

localizations.en: With those two, they're better off finding their own fun rather than following someone else's itinerary anyway.

999008199.text:
これでしばらくは生き延びられる……
とはいえ、あくまでしばらくの間だけど

localizations.en: At least we'll survive for a while... Though it really is only for a while.

999008199.text:
あの強さのドラゴンを軽く従えられる……
やっぱり強いのね、ヘルトとゼロって

localizations.en: They can command a dragon that powerful so easily... Held and Zero really are incredibly strong.

999008199.text:
うん。結局あの二人は楽しんでるのさ。
本気を出せば僕らを軽々なぎ倒せるんだから

localizations.en: Yeah. In the end, those two are just having fun. If they got serious, they could mow us down without breaking a sweat.

999008199.text:
すでにホルハーツとかは見物してたみたいだけど、
読み通り島で騒ぎは起こしてない

localizations.en: Sounds like they've already visited places like Holhartz, but just like we predicted, they haven't caused any trouble on the islands.

999008199.text: 上機嫌で遊んでいる分には、大人しいはずだよ

localizations.en: As long as they're enjoying themselves and in a good mood, they should stay docile.

999008199.text:
これで、二人の考えがこっちに寄ってくれたら言うこと
ないんだけどね。いつまで平和が続くことやら……

localizations.en: Now if only we could get them to come around to our way of thinking... Who knows how long this peace will last though...

999008199.text:
これからは一層気を引き締めて、
「九偉人図」を集めなくちゃってことですね

localizations.en: Which means we need to be even more careful going forward and focus on collecting the Portraits of the Nine.

999008199.text:
ああ、そうだったわ。次はベスティラよね？
エルスとタイニーに会いに行かなきゃ

localizations.en: Right, that's what we were doing. Bestira's next, isn't it? We need to go meet Els and Tiny.

999008199.text: ブラオールの港に出発だね

localizations.en: Off to the port in Braulle, then.

999008199.text:
うん。でもその前に……ちょっとだけいい？
改めてみんなに言っておきたいの

localizations.en: Yeah. But before that... can I say something? I want to tell everyone how I feel.

999008199.text: ヴァレリア？

私の兄弟……九偉人は、パルメ族の指示で
人間たちを「管理」しようとしている

localizations.en: My siblings... the Miraculous Nine are trying to 'manage' humanity under orders from the Palme.

999008199.text:
でも、私はその「管理」に反対。
九偉人も……パルメ族も、別に偉くもなんともない

localizations.en: But I oppose that 'management.' The Nine... and the Palme, for that matter... they're not special or superior.

999008199.text:
言い切ってくれるねぇ、まぁ同意さ。
長く生きてるだけだ

localizations.en: You really tell it like it is. I agree, though. They've just been around longer, that's all.

999008199.text:
私はレスナの叶えたいことを手伝いたい……
そう思ってたし、今も思ってる。でも

localizations.en: I wanted to help you achieve your dream, Resna... I still do. But...

999008199.text:
私にもやりたいことができた。兄弟のこと……
九偉人の問題は私がけりを付けたいの

localizations.en: Now I have something I want to do too. The situation with my siblings... with the Nine—I want to settle it myself.

999008199.text: ヴァレリア……

ヘルトの性格、見たでしょ？　あんな奴の親玉に
「管理」なんてますます任せられないわよ

localizations.en: You saw what Held's like, right? There's no way I can let someone like his boss 'manage' anything.

999008199.text:
キューンなんか、ずっと怯えちゃってたし。
可哀そうに、そりゃあ、ああなるよ

localizations.en: And poor Quinn was terrified the whole time. Can't blame her for being like that.

999008199.text:
うん、まずはあの子のことを助けてあげたいわ。
記憶にはないけど、かわいい妹なんだし

localizations.en: Yeah, I want to help her first. I don't remember her, but she is my cute little sister.

999008199.text:
キューンは潜在能力がヘルトやゼロに
匹敵するから、二人も目をかけてるんだろうね

localizations.en: Quinn's latent abilities rival Held's and Zero's, so those two probably keep an eye on her because of that.

999008199.text:
というか、末っ子の面倒を見ようと思ってるんだろう。
ヘル兄なりにさ。そういう兄貴っぽさはあるよ

localizations.en: More like they're looking after their baby sister. That's what Held thinks he's doing, anyway. He's got that big brother thing going on.

999008199.text: ただ、暴君がすぎる

localizations.en: He's just way too tyrannical about it.

999008199.text:
ヴァレリアの思うまま、やりたいようにしなよ。
何があっても、アタシはお前さんの味方だよ

localizations.en: Do what you want, Valeria. Whatever happens, I've got your back.

999008199.text:
ええ、ありがとう。
なんだか……お姉ちゃんみたい

localizations.en: Thank you. You're like... a real big sister.

999008199.text:
……ふ、なに言ってるんだい。
本当に姉なんだから、当たり前だろう？

localizations.en: ...Heh. What are you talking about? I am your real sister, so of course I am.

999008199.text: ふふ……

さて、色々片付いたところで、
いよいよベスティラに行くわよ！　しゅっぱーつ！！

localizations.en: All right, now that everything's settled, it's finally time to head to Bestira! Let's go!!

999008199.text: おー！
おー！
おー！
